background: Barclays PLC is the listed holding company of the Barclays group, a UK universal bank with a large transatlantic corporate and investment bank alongside UK retail banking and international cards.
synthesis: Ratings are A- on average across all three main agencies, the weakest of them at BBB+, all three on a stable outlook, with the last move a one-notch upgrade by one of them on 19 May 2023; the gap to the operating bank is the usual holding-company subordination. Capital and liquidity both screen strong against UK majors: CET1 of 14.3% is in the top quarter, and leverage of 4.9%, LCR of 158% and NSFR of 136% are all above their medians. LCR has fallen 20 points since 30 Jun 2025 while the other ratios are broadly flat (figures to 30 Jun 2026). The newest flagged item, on 25 Sep 2026, is a senior trading departure, with older items on risk-platform outages and a regulatory probe.
